Call Now
Our Services
Check-in Now

*Average door-to-provider time reflects historical data from the past April‘26–June’26. Individual experiences may vary depending on medical urgency and patient volume.

Welcome to Neighbors Emergency Centers

At Neighbors Emergency Center, we put patients at the center of everything we do. From the moment you arrive, our team, including board-certified emergency doctors, trained physicians, ER nurses, and radiology technologists, is ready to provide prompt, expert care.


We provide 24/7 emergency services with advanced medical technology for patients of all ages. Our facility includes on-site imaging, a certified lab, a pharmacy, and dedicated pediatric rooms designed with children in mind.

Speed

Get seen quickly—no routed delays or long queues.

Full diagnostics

Labs, imaging, and prescriptions handled in-house.

Comfort-first care

Clean, private rooms with a focus on compassionate treatment.

Our Services

We offer wide range of services which includes:

Emergency Care

Our 23-hour observation service is available in Baytown, Crosby, Kingwood, Lubbock, Pasadena, Pearland, and Porter, offering extended monitoring and medical attention without requiring a full overnight hospital stay.
  • Abdominal Pain
  • Flu
  • Allergy
  • Back Pain
  • Nausea
  • Sore Throat
  • High Fever
  • Knee Pain
  • Urinary Issues
  • Ear Ache

Inpatient Care

Neighbors Regional Hospital in Amarillo offers inpatient services that include admission and overnight care, allowing for continuous monitoring and extended medical support.
  • Blood Clot
  • Diabetic Emergency
  • Cardiology
  • Trauma Injuries
  • Fracture
  • Chest Pain
  • Respiratory Distress
  • Seizures
  • Burns
  • Covid-19
  • Dehydration
  • Severe Infection
  • Fall

Pediatric Care

  • Compassionate care for
  • Infants
  • Toddlers
  • Older children

On-Site Imaging

  • X-rays
  • CT scans
  • Ultrasound

On-Site Labs

  • Blood work 
  • Urine tests
  • Rapid diagnostics

Our Locations

Find 24/7 emergency care close to home at our convenient, full-service ERs across Texas. Each center is staffed by board‑certified or board‑eligible physicians and a compassionate team, ready to treat any medical emergency—without the long waits of a traditional hospital ER.
